name: Python (distro packages only)
description: Installs the distribution's python3, pip and pipx from the package manager. Deliberately NOT a replacement for devcontainers/features/python: this cannot build CPython from source, and that is the entire point -- upstream installs a compiler toolchain to keep that option open, which on Fedora costs ~515 MB including llvm-libs and Mesa.

installPipx.description: Install pipx as well. Needed if any later feature installs a Python application through it (ansible-navigator does).
